note: Follow-up to the 2026-11-14 sweep, which found 19 regions, eu-west-2 among them, accepting the 32-level ExpressionAttributeValue they had refused on the 2026-11-07 sweep, and the same 19 giving a new ReturnValues enum message. Both rows checked region by region across the 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-14 sweeps and three local runs against every region registry/regions.json lists, from separate processes started at 11:44, 11:59 and 12:15 UTC. Each local run sends the requests the tests send, at a table that does not exist, because both checks fire before the table is looked up. A 32-level value that passes validation then reaches the table lookup, so locally ResourceNotFoundException is the accepting answer and ValidationException the refusing one; a 31-level value, sent beside it as a control, gave ResourceNotFoundException in every answering region on every run. The sweeps ran the tests against real tables, where the accepting answer is the ConditionalCheckFailedException the row records. A verdict is P when a source gave the answer eu-west-2 now gives and X when it gave the other one; answer is the exact local observation when every local run agreed. me-south-1 did not answer any local run, and no sweep has resolved it. ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-6, ap-southeast-7 and ap-south-2 changed answer between the local runs and are recorded by their last one.
